item.title: SideStore v0.6.3
item.description:
SideStore 0.6.3 | SideStore
# ⚠️**Please Reinstall With [iloader](https://iloader.app/)**⚠️ If you have updated to iOS 26.4+ and are receiving VPN errors. ## What's Changed * Small fixes by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1020 * Fix expired Discord link in README.md by @Or3nges in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1101 * Update error codes by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1078 * LocalDevVPN by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1126 * Sources: Update/Remove Sources from Trusted Sources by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1131 * Adds StikDebug AltSource by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1137 * Update pairing file help link in alert by @basketshoe in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1147 * Authentication rework by @hugeBlack in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1151 * Update Trusted Sources by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1152 * Update trustedapps.json by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1153 * Update Trusted Sources by @peroka-net in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1160 * Feature: AppId customization during manual IPA install via "My Apps" screen by @mahee96 in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1158 * Fix issues profile/afc and use main profile issue by @hugeBlack in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1183 * feat: add Mona to Trusted Sources by @suprstarrd in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1210 * Fix widget not working & Only run turn off data shortcut when minimuxer is not ready and below 26.4 by @hugeBlack in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1218 * LC Source Update by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1253
## New Contributors * @Or3nges made their first contribution in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1101 * @basketshoe made their first contribution in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1147 * @peroka-net made their first contribution in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1160 * @suprstarrd made their first contribution in https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/1210
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.6.2...0.6.3
